description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.
